title: World Template Manifest
description: The manifest.json file for a Minecraft Bedrock Edition world template. World templates package a complete world that players can use as a starting point for new worlds. They can include custom terrain, structures, and associated resource/behavior packs.

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: The format version of this manifest file. Use 2 for modern templates.

header.title: Header
header.description:
The header section containing the template's identity: name, description, unique UUID, version, and base_game_version.

Properties:
• modules
• dependencies

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Declares modules within the template. For world templates, use type 'world_template'.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.description: Optional list of behavior and resource packs this template depends on.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Optional metadata about the template including author names and license.

pack_behavior_pack_rest_of_file.title: Behavior Pack Content
pack_behavior_pack_rest_of_file.description: Defines the non-header content section of a behavior pack document.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description:
Properties:
• description
• language (string)
• type (string)
• uuid (string)
• version (string)
• entry (string)

language.description: The scripting language of this module (e.g., 'javascript').

entry.description: Script entry point for this behavior pack.
